title: Gold, Silver, Stocks: Why Bonds Deserve a Place on Your Dhanteras Shopping List
summary: Traditionally, investors have turned to gold and silver on Dhanteras, but this trend is shifting. By including bonds in their investment strategy, individuals can ensure they meet their financial requirements without rushing to liquidate assets.

title: Sebi revises currency derivative norms for domestic investors, FPIs; allows to trade up to USD 5 mn
summary: Sebi has revised its regulations to permit domestic and foreign portfolio investors to take positions in currency derivatives. Investors can now hold up to USD 5 million without establishing underlying exposure. The new guidelines also require FPIs to ensure their short positions do not exceed this limit. For amounts above the threshold, FPIs must have underlying exposure in Indian debt or equity securities.

title: Fed's Beth Hammack favors gradual rate-hike path to lower inflation

She proposes implementing smaller, more frequent adjustments to minimize impacts on households and markets. Dissatisfied with the last Fed meeting's outcome, Hammack argues that the current monetary policy lacks sufficient restrictiveness.

title: Sebi approves net settlement of cash market trades for mutual funds
summary: India’s Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has greenlit the introduction of net settlement for mutual fund schemes, set to take effect on April 1, 2027. This initiative is designed to streamline funding requirements and boost market efficiency. Previously, net settlement was exclusive to foreign portfolio investors. Eligible transactions will now be confined to sales or purchases of a specific security, while cross-scheme netting will remain prohibited.
